settings.header: Pitangus can't start: fix these settings in the environment (.env).
settings.invalid_flag: {{name}}={{value}} isn't a yes/no value: use 1 or 0 (also true/false, on/off).
settings.invalid_url: {{name}}={{value}} isn't an origin such as https://pitangus.example.com (scheme and host, no path).
settings.invalid_key: {{name}} must be 32 random bytes in base64. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32
settings.short_token: {{name}} is too short: use at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32).
settings.invalid_addresses: {{name}}={{value}} isn't a comma-separated list of IP addresses or CIDR ranges (at most {{max}}), such as 203.0.113.10, 2001:db8::/48.

identity_gate.title: Canonical identity gate (last two full analyses of each repository)
identity_gate.row: fingerprints +{{v1_opened}}/-{{v1_gone}} · identities +{{v2_opened}}/-{{v2_gone}}, {{recounted}} recounted · {{findings}} findings in {{families}} families
identity_gate.passed: Gate passed: the same commit opens and fixes nothing either way.
identity_gate.failed: Gate not passed: a repository scanned twice on one commit changed, or none was. Set PITANGUS_IDENTITY_MODE=shadow until it passes.
identity_gate.title_scan: Canonical identity gate: {{path}} scanned twice on the same commit
identity_gate.incomplete: A scan was incomplete: an engine didn't run, so nothing is proven.
identity_gate.failed_scan: Gate not passed: the same commit changed between two scans, or a scan was incomplete.
